title: Preparation and Planning
description: The single most controllable predictor of negotiation success. Preparation means clarifying interests, estimating their BATNA, setting aspiration and reservation points, and planning your opening.

sections.title: What It Is
sections.content: The single most controllable predictor of negotiation success. Preparation means clarifying interests, estimating their BATNA, setting aspiration and reservation points, and planning your opening.

sections.title: How It Actually Appears
content: The negotiator who walks in with a one-page sheet summarizing their numbers, interests, and possible trades.
The unprepared negotiator who opens with 'So, what are you thinking?' and then reacts all day.

sections.title: Practical Preparation Routine
content: Write your aspiration (optimistic goal) and your reservation (walk-away).
Plan your opening line and anchor.
Identify one objective standard (industry data, precedent, market rate) you can reference.

sections.title: Common Mistake
sections.content: Preparing only your own side. The most effective negotiators spend as much time imagining the other party's constraints, pressures, and alternatives as their own.

sections.title: Key Insight
sections.content: Preparation is the difference between a negotiator and someone who's just having a tense conversation.
